summary: The note covers two closures in the history of Levi Strauss & Co. In 2002 the company shut its Valencia Street plant in San Francisco, which had opened the same year as the city's April 1906 earthquake. By the end of 2003 its last U.S. factory, in San Antonio, closed, ending 150 years of jeans made in the USA. Production of some higher-end, more expensive jeans later resumed in the US several years afterward.
one_line: Covers Levi Strauss & Co.'s closure of its Valencia Street plant in 2002 and its last U.S. factory in San Antonio in 2003.
